name: 2024-1c-parcial1
title: Sims Hotels
description: A space hotel simulation (Hotel, Floor, Room, guests typed by symbol) written by another team with technical debt. The student must fix instance creation, replace nil/#reserved guest hacks with explicit room states, restore encapsulation between Hotel and Floor, make three failing Room tests pass, and remove duplicated and imperative loop code using collection protocol.

design.notes: Room status is encoded as nil guest or a #reserved guest-type symbol and must become explicit state objects, while Hotel iterates floor rooms with index-based whileTrue loops that must be replaced by delegation to Floor and collection messages.
